# RC61 — Terminal Panel Foundation

Date: 2026-07-28

Workspace: `/path/to/projects/w.scrpt`

Git: not a Git repository in this workspace; checkpoint identity is the source tree at this path plus the artifacts below.

## Change

- Added `Esc t p` / `task.terminal-panel` / `Terminal Panel`.
- Added `:terminal-panel`, `:term-panel`, `:shell-panel`, and `:pty-panel`.
- Terminal Panel is a read-only in-editor context surface for the workspace shell route.
- The panel shows workspace root, `$SHELL`, `TERM`, detected SSH/mosh/tmux route, terminal size, last full-screen shell return status, task state, and captured task-output bytes.
- `Esc t t` remains the real full-screen workspace-shell handoff; the panel does not request shell input or claim live embedded PTY I/O.
- Session layout now persists terminal-panel visibility and reopens the panel on pathless restore without storing shell scrollback, task output, or unsaved text.
- Updated README and the real-iPad QA matrix to document the terminal-panel route and preserve the embedded-PTY limitation.

## Open gate

- No real iPad/Blink/mosh/hardware feel approval is claimed. `docs/IPAD_BLINK_QA.md` remains the hardware release gate.
- Live embedded terminal pane/PTY I/O is not claimed. `Esc t t` is still a full-screen shell handoff; `Esc t p` is a read-only panel foundation.
- Clipboard success, Escape delivery, modifier mappings, resize behavior, reconnect behavior, and touch/trackpad feel require real Blink/iPad validation.
